rolling-waivers.title: Rolling waiver priority
rolling-waivers.pitch: Use a claim, drop to the back of the line. No more weekly reset that hands the worst team first dibs every week.

reset-waivers.title: Reset waiver order every week
reset-waivers.pitch: Waiver order resets weekly by standings: worst record picks first.

one-day-waivers.title: Shorter waiver period (1 day)
one-day-waivers.pitch: Dropped players clear waivers in 24 hours instead of 48. Faster pickups.

move-limit-5.title: Cap pickups at 5 per week
move-limit-5.pitch: Five adds a week, max. Stops the streaming arms race.

pass-td-6.title: 6-point passing touchdowns
pass-td-6.pitch: QBs get 6 for a TD pass instead of 4. Quarterbacks matter more.

half-ppr.title: Half-point PPR
half-ppr.pitch: Receptions worth 0.5 instead of 1. Running backs back in style.

trade-review-1-day.title: Faster trades (1-day review)
trade-review-1-day.pitch: Trades go through after 1 day of review instead of 2.
